messages:
maya: quick alert  sparkbridge-7b-int4 shows a 5.2% EM drop vs float16 on the curated goldset. any curation merges recently?

ishaan: which goldset + run?

maya: goldsets/sparkbridge/gold_2026-03/gold_v4.jsonl, run qbench-173210, seed=11. summary: exact_match 0.889 -> 0.842, regressions mostly token-split and missing trailing punctuation.

zoe: we did a sampling shuffle last week to reduce anchor bias, and dedupe threshold was relaxed from 0.95->0.90 during that job. could be near-dupe noise.

maya: triage plan: (1) regen tokens with tokenizer v2 (current prod) and v3 (new) and compute tok-diff (2) rerun dedupe at 0.96 and 0.98 and compare fail-overlap (3) push top-150 fails to label queue if overlap remains high.

ishaan: commands: 
```
python -m curation.dedupe --input gold_v4.jsonl --thresh 0.96 --out gold_v4.dedupe_096.jsonl
python -m curation.tokenize --input gold_v4.dedupe_096.jsonl --tokenizer v2 --out gold_v4.tok_v2.jsonl
python -m curation.tokdiff --a gold_v4.tok_v2.jsonl --b gold_v4.tok_v3.jsonl --out tokdiff_qbench173210.json
```

labeler-bot: [qbench-ci] qbench-173210 started: model=sparkbridge-7b-int4 input=gold_v4.tok_v2.jsonl

zoe: capacity note: contractors + internal can handle 150 today if marked 'expedite'. i'll own label coordination.

maya: exported failure set to s3://redwood-curation/exports/qbench-173210-fails.jsonl (dedupe=0.96 run). uploading tok-diff now. will report overlap numbers in 30m.

ishaan: if tok-diff small and dedupe@0.98 restores metrics, we should revert the sampling shuffle and re-run a conservative merge. otherwise escalate kernel bisect.

maya: owners: maya = datasets + exports, ishaan = reproduce/ kernel-bisect if needed, zoe = label ops. meeting in 40m.
